claims.title: Calibrate independent graphlike faults and protect rare logical readout

quoted_fields.interface: One Pauli-error sector of a planar surface code encoding ONE logical qubit over a finite window of repeated noisy syndrome measurements. Independent binary graphlike fault mechanisms; contractible spacetime region with two distinct connected rough boundary components; known initialization or preparation faults included. Actual finite code/boundary matrices satisfy H_check=(B_H)_internal and im S_stabilizer=ker B_H,checked by the source-prescribed binary elimination on the actual supplied code. For unknown-rate calibration: stationary rates across independent repetitions of the SAME schedule,bounded detector degreeDelta,and promised fixed0<p_min<=p_e<=p_max<1/2. Calibration identifiability requires the stated unique interior-edge/separable boundary factors; no detector may hide distinct factors to both rough components,and parallel mechanisms merge only with the same detector incidence AND logical effect. A separated distance>=3 patch is the supplied sufficient example. External general nonnegative perfect-matching counting FPRAS has relative accuracy1+/-eta and worst-case polynomial bit time,includinglog(1/delta),as explicitly named in the source. Calibration/model promises do not certify arbitrary hardware noise.
quoted_fields.failure: Completed source-reported independent-graphlike reference case is not the selected full correlation-aware physical decoder. Local Pauli X/Z correlations and coupled spacetime joint class weights remain missing; a four-port obstruction excludes LOCAL nonnegative matching gadgets,not all global representations or a hardness theorem. No general matching FPRAS was implemented/benchmarked; polynomial existence and a large proof comparison constant do not establish useful decoder latency or practical advantage. Unknown-rate calibration is polynomial in p_min^-1 and inverse moment bounds,not merely rate-description bit length; fixed rate bounds and bounded degree matter. Destructive logical readout consumes the encoded state and provides classical output,not a coherent quantum decoder port. Arbitrary topology/many logical qubits,non-Pauli/coherent or nonstationary/misspecified hardware noise are outside the earned model. No new Capital/root scientific verification/audit,physical experiment,novelty/priority certification or completed civilisation-level capability is claimed. Source UI explanations and source-reported finite checks are not independent audits.
